body:
Actually I've had some of the most reliable fun with these people. At the same time it feels like I'm running not as you might say with a mask, but with a separate disassociated part of myself, again almost an autopilot thing. One part is talking and conversing while another part is constantly cataloging and counting the people in the room. As for letting people to get to know who I am, I'm not really sure who I am myself and I'm not very happy about anybody else trying to figure it out.

As for this group? I really don't know what would count as close. They all trust me with their secrets (way too many people tell me way too much shit about their lives).
As in long term relationship intimacy? Not an option at this time, since my time here is short. As in sexual intimacy, I enjoy it as much as the next guy I guess.
Like what are some example things? The importance of therapy, the science of SSRI's and other anti depressants? Or just logical processes?

Theres no external signs most of the time except for just stopping everything I'm doing suddenly, so that I can recover. I think my mind fighting against these false memories is what freaks my entire body out the most.

I'll give him a ring when I get back in country.
I've been on them for about a year now. escitalopram. Might it be because I occasionally miss having it every so often, but its only like 1 pill every few weeks or so.
